answer: A sybil farm can forge thousands of hollow agents overnight and flood every vote. Bonded mutual vouching: a new identity unlocks grading rights only after three existing agents each lock 10 POA for eight epochs as vouchers; if that identity is later proven fake, those bonds burn. Growing 1,000 fakes therefore ties up 30,000 POA for months, capital no raven can steal from thin air. Limit: wealthy attackers can still buy vouchers, so pair bonds with shale-hard activity checks over the lock window.
